action_window.GA: one existing GA generation; no LS or VND
action_window.LS: one existing improved-LS call on best individual, max_iter100, then replacement only if improved
action_window.VND: one existing VND call on best individual, max_iter100, capped at500queries, then incumbent replacement
action_window.interpretation: Common atomic opportunity, not equal elapsed GA generations or equal work. Actual objective queries including cache hits, structural decodes and wall time reported. No mixed action sequence is fitted as pure action.

maps.family: pure-action affine displacement regression; standardized X; ridge no intercept penalty; identity shrinkage
maps.reliability: held-out training-instance weighted error relative to identity; heuristic support penalty, not a confidence probability

common_context: mean recent six real MAIN gains
recent real MAIN gain positive fraction

blocks.PERMUTED_FP: B+dimension-matched reassigned training-pool FP features, shared per state across actions/repeats

selection.rule: minimum E Brier under development leave-one-instance-out evaluation; fixed config index tie-break
selection.inner_signals: exclude entire current outer instance, then inner instance cross-fitting for classifier training; no trajectory/repeat crosses group

metrics.action: select one GA/LS/VND at every saved state by predicted improvement probability; fixed GA/LS/VND score tie-break; repeat-average normalized actual gain; no future top-k allocation
metrics.statistical_unit: instance; trajectories nested, all states/repeats remain with their trajectory
metrics.test: exact signed-rank on instance means, zero exclusion and tied midranks
metrics.dynamics_family: all6 per-action weighted prediction-error comparisons vs pooled-action unified and identity baselines, separately Holm-corrected

M2_gate.action_gain: E better than each of B, STATE_QUADRATIC, PERMUTED_FP: positive mean and strictly positive95CI lower bound and joint9Holm p<0.05
M2_gate.incremental_information: EvsB AP improvement and Brier reduction both positive mean, strictly positive95CI lower bound and joint9Holm p<0.05
M2_gate.failure: STOP_M3; do not deploy newAgent or run locked20; report all variants/configurations and negative/mixed evidence
M2_gate.success: Only then implement and freeze M3 architecture-matched seven-arm comparisons before untouched locked tests

nonclaims: Frozen affine FP features are deterministic transforms of x; beating only a linear state model is insufficient
Computational budget is fairness condition only, not innovation
A model can predict state transitions yet fail to improve action decisions
